verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents converting Word docx and reading Excel spreadsheets, and it can produce PDF through external engines such as LaTeX or wkhtmltopdf. That covers Word-to-PDF and some movement between office formats. PowerPoint is never mentioned in the evidence, Excel is input-only, and community reports note PDF table breakage and slow Word conversion. Missing for 10: any PowerPoint support, Excel output, a PDF path that needs no external engine, and hands-on confirmation of office-to-PDF fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: Pandoc can convert between numerous markup and word processing formats, including, but not limited to, various flavors of Markdown, HTML, LaTeX and Word docx.
To produce a PDF, specify an output file with a .pdf extension: pandoc test.txt -o test.pdf
via pdflatex, lualatex, xelatex, latexmk, tectonic, wkhtmltopdf, weasyprint, prince, pagedjs-cli, context, or pdfroff.
